comment: Example room set (roadmap F11): five halves written by tools/templates/make_rooms.py, used only by the scenario room_sets (Hyrule Castle with RoomSet Example). Coordinates in pixels of the half room (256 wide, 128 or 256 tall), on the 8 px grid; the half is the top of the room and the converter joins it with a flipped half below.

halves.name: Hall
halves.comment: Plain hall with every door; hosts the four kinds of section (corner, middle, wide, strip).

halves.name: Notched
halves.comment: Top corners cut away (like template 11139), a pool on the middle line that the bottom half mirrors.

halves.name: Gallery
halves.comment: Tall half (the joined room is 1x2) with spike strips and the four kinds of section.

halves.name: Basin
halves.comment: Room on the lower floor: upper wall ring, lower walls and floor inside it, every lower door.

halves.name: Ledges
halves.comment: Lower floor with its top corners cut (like template 40419): the upper walls follow it 24 px out.
